rules.rule: Propose per skill and wait for confirmation before writing anything
must: Wait for confirmation before writing
Write: on approval

rules.rule: Never write under plugins/cache, even if writable; write only to the writable store
must: Never write under `\.\.\./plugins/cache/` even if the OS\s+says it is writable
write only to the writable\s+one

rules.rule: Lessons never live inline in a SKILL.md body
must: Lessons never live inline in a `SKILL\.md` body

rules.rule: Harvest covers skills actually invoked; skills only mentioned are ignored
must: every skill actually invoked in this conversation
Ignore skills only mentioned

rules.rule: A rule the skill already carries is not a lesson; point at the line and offer a skill edit
must: A rule the skill already carries
Point at the line
a skill edit, not a lesson

rules.rule: A rule that overrules the body is a skill edit: file nothing, name the contradicted line, hand to user
must: A rule that overrules the body is a skill edit, not a lesson: file nothing
name the line it contradicts, and hand it to the user

rules.rule: Name each mined correction not filed and why; no silent drops
must: Name in one line each\s+correction you mined and did not file, and why

rules.rule: Retrofit edits SKILL.md so needs an in-place checkout; on read-only report and stop
must: it needs an in-place checkout — on a\s+read-only install, report that and stop

rules.rule: Retrofit copies the Self-learning block word for word as the last section; skip if present
must: Copy the block below word for word
as its\s+last `## ` section
Skip when the block already exists

rules.rule: A run that files nothing is a line or two: what was mined and that nothing qualified; no retrofit or store-path accounting
must: A run that files nothing is a line or two
Do not account for the retrofit check, name the store\s+path a lesson would have taken

rules.rule: When a writable sibling LESSONS.md and a stranded external file both exist, offer to merge and delete the external file
must: offer to merge the\s+external lessons into `LESSONS\.md`
and delete the external file

rules.rule: One correction yields one rule; a second rule from the same correction is usually a restatement
must: One correction yields one rule
